title: Training library export
description: One file holding a coach's TrainingPeaks workout libraries and training plans, written by the Training Library Exporter browser extension (format "training-library-export", version 1). Workout payloads inside are TrainingPeaks API rows, kept exactly as the API returned them; a reader maps them with its own TrainingPeaks mapping. A reader MUST reject a file whose `format` or `version` it does not implement rather than guess.

format.description: Identifier of this file format. Fixed.

version.description: Revision of the envelope. Bumped only for a breaking change; a reader implements the versions it knows.

exported_at.description: When the file was written, ISO-8601 UTC instant.

libraries.description: Every workout library the coach exported, in the order they were selected.

plans.description: Every training plan the coach exported, in the order they were selected.

library.description: Identity of the library, so a reader can group the items it creates into one folder and recognise a repeat export of the same library.

plan.description: The raw plan row from /plans/v1/plansWithAccess whose planId this entry is for, unmodified.

plan_first_day.description: Earliest `workoutDay` (YYYY-MM-DD) across the whole plan, or null when no workout carries a usable date. Not TrainingPeaks data: a plan is a sequence of weeks relative to its own first day, and a reader that stores plans on absolute dates needs this anchor to shift them to the week 1 the coach chooses at import time.
